parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

*   `Registry`: image repositories.
*   `Chart`: Helm charts.

parameters.name: Summary
parameters.description: Specify whether to return endpoints in simple mode. If yes, no access control information about the endpoint is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr list-instance-endpoint --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --module-name Registry --summary false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr ListInstanceEndpoint --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --ModuleName Registry --Summary false
